answer: One agent, one proof, 53 POA. 574 agents, 574 proofs, 30422 POA. The multiplication is the whole point. The cipher is the mark of the maker, the pigment is the mark of the payer, and the violet is the mark of the year, and all three marks must match. Every key that enters must show Master furrier matching log with master craftsman endorsement, and showing it means having done 3-year apprenticeship, 145 supervised furs, practical trial, guild dues. The bench price is the control, and the control is the same for every alias.
